messages.text: Happy birthday, {nickname}! Everything good in me started with you. Thank you for your love, your patience and your blessings. Wishing you good health and many happy years 🙏
Happy birthday, {nickname}! You have given us so much and asked for so little. Today is all about you. Love you always ❤️
Happy birthday, my love! Every day with you is a gift, and today I get to celebrate the best one. Here's to you and to us ❤️
Happy birthday, {nickname}! Still the only person who can annoy me and make me laugh in the same minute. Have the best day 🎂
Happy birthday, {nickname}! Have a fantastic day and an even better year ahead 🎉
Happy birthday, {name}! Wishing you lots of laughter, good food and great company today 🥳
Wishing you a very happy birthday, {name}. May the year ahead bring you good health, success and happiness.
Happy birthday, {nickname}! Wishing you a wonderful day and a year full of happiness 🎂
Many happy returns of the day, {nickname}! Stay happy and healthy always 🎉
Happy birthday, {nickname}! Your blessings mean everything to us. Wishing you good health, peace and many more years with all of us 🙏
Happy {age_th} birthday, {nickname}! What a beautiful milestone. Wishing you health, joy and many more wonderful years 🎉
{age} years of making the world better! Happy birthday, {nickname}. Today we celebrate you 🥳
Happy anniversary, my love! Thank you for every laugh, every hard day we got through together, and every ordinary moment that feels special with you ❤️
Happy {years_th} anniversary! I would choose you again, every single time ❤️
Happy anniversary, {couple_names}! Wishing you both a lifetime of love, laughter and togetherness 💐
Happy anniversary! May your bond grow stronger with every year. Lots of love to you both 💐
Happy {years_th} anniversary! You have shown us what real togetherness looks like. Wishing you both good health and many more happy years 🙏
Congratulations on your work anniversary, {name}! Your dedication inspires everyone around you. Wishing you continued success.
Congratulations on your engagement, {nickname}! So happy for you both. Wishing you a lifetime of love 💍
Congratulations, {nickname}! So proud of you. Wishing you all the success ahead 🎉
Many congratulations, {name}! You truly deserve this. Keep shining ✨
Belated happy birthday, {nickname}! Sorry I'm late, but my wishes are just as warm. Hope you had a lovely day 🎂
I missed the day but not the love! Belated wishes, {nickname}. Hope it was a wonderful one 💐
Happy {festival}! Wishing you and your family joy, good health and prosperity 🙏
Thank you so much for the lovely wishes! It really made my day 😊
Thank you for remembering my birthday! Your wishes mean a lot 🙏
Thinking of you today, {nickname}! Wishing you all the very best 😊
